reviews.review_description: We are extremely happy with our recent solar battery installation from Aussie Solar Batteries.The entire process, from initial consultation to final commissioning, was swift and professional. Our Sales Consultant, Noah, was fantastic—knowledgeable, transparent, and ensured we got the right solution for our needs without any pressure.The installation team was equally impressive. The electrician and the two other installers worked incredibly diligently. They were professional, efficient, and clearly took pride in their work, completing the complex installation quickly and neatly. We truly appreciate their dedication and professionalism.A massive thank you to Noah and the entire Aussie Solar Batteries team for a flawless experience! Highly recommend their services.Surprisingly, this installer wasn't suggested via the search I did via Solar Quotes. It was recommended by ta friend of mine and they turned out to be really good and affordable.
Everything installed and working well. Complicated setup as we have a 2 phase house.

Aussie Solar Batteries was an easy company to deal with, gave me all the info I asked for to make the right decision on what I wanted.Battery and inverter was installed by a local trade and was done just how I wanted and even tidied up after themselves.Had a little hiccup with the recharging after a couple of days but Aussie Solar called me and sorted it over the phone and got it all working again.Very happy with my purchase.

I had a great experience all round with ASB. The salesman on my initial phone call wasn't pushy but was very informative, and quickly sent over a comprehensive quote. Once I signed the contract, I waited a few weeks for an install date, which was very reasonable given how busy they are since the introduction of the battery rebates.The install of my new 13kW solar system, 42kWh FoxESS battery and 10kW inverter was all done in a single day - the team were professional, did a clean job and tidied up after themselves. Everything has been working perfectly since, and I didn't have to pay a cent until 7 days post-install - I know that some companies require a deposit, but ASB don't. Overall, highly recommended.
Good product, very reasonable price, easy to communicate, clean and tidy installation. Highly recommend

Good company, easy to deal with, reliable, professional , good product, no stress at all. You will enjoy the experience of being fully self-sufficient. The app is good.  I have the battery on the side of the house—no problem at all.

We had a fantastic experience with Aussie Solar Batteries from sales to installation. Best value company and shout out to Paul and Jackson who did a great job installing the battery.  Highly recommend if you want great value and great service.
1. On time, good communication2. No issue with installation, as described3. Software works fine and is all good.
Aussie Solar Batteries has provided very good price on the solar batteries and also provided excellent and professional installation services.

I purchased a Fox ESS 10kW Hybrid inverter and 42kWh EQ4800 battery stack from Aussie Solar Batteries. I was able to AC couple to integrate with my existing PV system. (6.6kW) After signing up, I was a little nervous, but visiting the Sydney Showroom and speaking with Phil alleviated my concerns. Also, the fact that no deposit or payment was required until after the installation was complete gave me further peace of mind. Naz and Matthias were very helpful and responsive through the cooling off period and installation booking, to answer my queries about the system design and implementation, along with providing updates on the status of approvals and progress. Overall, I am very happy and would recommend Aussie Solar Batteries.

Unbeatable price. I investigated Fox ESS (42 kwh) and to the best of my research it is a serious player with good quality. I've started getting Amber set up (takes a week). So far the battery is working well and covers our needs. Installation went well - got four back-up circuits for free. Didn't get any documentation, but a search on Grok helped me troubleshoot. The app is working well. Thanks to Phil for helping and reassuring, and to the installers for your kindness and hard work.
The best product, best service and best post installation follow up. Finally I have the freedom for unlimited use of the electricity. Love to recommend.
They took my case very seriously and provided effective solutions and great service. Really responsible team — I could clearly see the results of their work.

Sales process was simple and Phil was always proactive in answering all my questions, which I had a lot.Installers were very friendly, polite and competent. They were punctual and provided calls 20min in advance of arrival as I requested.Customer service has all been coordinated through sales at this point but I have no reason to suspect that after sales service will match that through sales.Post install they were very active in assisting me to fine tune settings to ensure the operationwas as intended.I have only 2 minor points to make that are not 100% glowing:a) Unfortunately at the time of install, the battery was not fully integrated into major VPP players like Amber. I believe this is an issues across industry and across many battery brands so this is not unique.b) The integration with the solar battery app and the existing solar panel collection is not as seamless as I would like.Neither of these feedback points undermine the overall excellent experience received start to finish.

Dealing with Aussie Solar Batteries has been one of the easiest experiences! Emily in particular was our sales consultant from start to finish the process has been made easy and stress free. She has been super helpful and has gone above and beyond while helping me through the process of getting a battery. She put the time in to choosing whats right for my home, the installers also did a very good job they didn't leave any mess, were on time and installed the app and set it all up for me as well as showing me how to use it! Was impressed how quickly they got a team out for install also. If I could recommend any company to get a battery would be Aussie Solar :)

1st class customer service from Benji doing all the paper work as requiredSpeedy and quality  installation from the sparkyFollow up inspection by Sunny and his technical teamOne very satisfying customerTo early to verify the products but so far so good

I couldn’t be happier with the experience I had working with Aussie Solar Batteries for my solar battery installation. From the initial consultation to the final handover, their team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and genuine care for getting everything just right.They took the time to understand my energy needs, explained the options clearly, and provided a tailored solution that’s already making a noticeable difference. The installation was smooth, tidy, and completed ahead of schedule with minimal disruption to my home during the installation.What really impressed me was their attention to detail and post-installation support. They walked me through the system, helped set up the monitoring app, and made sure I felt confident using it. Now I’m storing solar energy during the day and using it at night cutting my power bills and boosting my energy independence.If you're considering solar battery installation, I wholeheartedly recommend Aussie Solar Batteries Group. They deliver top-tier service, cutting-edge technology, and peace of mind. A fantastic investment with a fantastic team!

The ASB group was referred to us by our friends, and it has truly been a great experience with the company! Everyone from the sales team, technicians, to the installation team have been extremely helpful, patient, professional and knowledgeable.They have provided the best design, solution and product. They pitched a plan tailored for our needs and didn’t try to sell anything we don’t need.Highly recommended to everyone!

Aussie Solar Batteries was just the best the option for myself. They offered a great deal for what seems by my own research a very competitive battery. Once my order was placed, within days a time was scheduled, the 2 engineers arrived in time, discussed my setup with, which was complicated as I had a solaredge inverter which needed to be kept due to my solaredge optimisers. They correctly identified I required AC coupled configuration and went about installing the battery and the FoxESS inverter.They configured backup switches and placed a protective screen over the battery as they saw it was going to be in direct sunlight.The entire job was done in 4 to 5 hours and the battery is just working. This is 3 weeks now and I'm very happy with the result
Abbie, the sale person was excellent, installation was difficult but the management rectified and did a great job and followed up, thank you
I am very happy for the quote, installation was smoothly, the electricians were polite, professional! They taught us how to use the App and charger, service perfect!
Great pricing. I got a barigan compared to what my friends paid for with similar batteries.

I already had solar panels installed a few years ago and spent months researching the right battery setup before signing with Aussie Solar Batteries. I was in constant contact with the owner, Sunny, asking endless questions about system design, inverter compatibility, battery sizing, how to remove my controlled hot water load and integrate a Catch Power solar relay, and how all of this would work with the GloBird ZeroHero electricity plan which gives three free hours of grid power each day.Sunny was incredibly patient and always happy to explain things clearly. His expert advice helped me confidently settle on a 42 kWh battery paired with an 8 kW DC-coupled inverter, which turned out to be the perfect solution for our household.As promised, no payment was required until after installation. About five weeks later, Andrew and his offsider came out to install the system. They were punctual, professional and even managed to relocate the battery and inverter three metres further down the house than originally planned without any fuss. The install was neat and done to a very high standard.I’ve now been running on the new battery and GloBird plan for over a week and haven’t once depleted the battery – even with a family of seven home throughout the day! Once I switch the hot water over to the Catch Power relay, I’ll be almost completely off-grid cost-wise, and at this rate I’m hoping the system will pay itself off in just 18 months.The price was unbeatable compared to every other supplier I spoke to. I saw people online saying it must be “too good to be true” or a scam – but I can confidently say my experience has been nothing but excellent. So much so that I’ve already recommended Sunny and his team to my whole family.Thank you, Sunny. Outstanding service, great communication and incredible value. Would happily use Aussie Solar Batteries again in a heartbeat.
Supervisor Sunny was so good.Install meter ct correct. Install auto change over switch.bill drop from 8 dollars to 0.2 per day
Sales process was very professional and installation was very clean.
